event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e; assigned deletion is crates/farhelm-ui/assets/vendor/xterm.js:2, module 9078 (ThemeService). TLDR: a terminal program can change its cursor color, but Farhelm continues drawing the bundled cursor color. A program querying the cursor color can receive its requested color even though the viewer draws another. This is a replacement-contract gap exposed by reviewing removal of the service that maintained cursor colors. Details: vendor/vte/src/ansi.rs:1491-1507 dispatches dynamic OSC colors through NamedColor::Cursor to set_color or a query. The emulator forwards set_color/reset_color (farhelm-terminal-emulator/src/queries.rs:357-358) and answers dynamic queries from term.colors before theme fallback (:476-486). However, supervisor grid_output.rs:329-362 builds Cursor from position, visibility, shape and blink only; :461-477 sends foreground/background overrides but no cursor-color override. Proto grid.rs:1040-1048,1128-1153 likewise provides no cursor-color field. On the page grid-style.js:225-233 always returns theme.cursor, and grid-terminal.js:792-819 uses that color for blocks, bars, underlines and unfocused outlines. Thus no cursor-color update reaches the painter. The removed ThemeService contains mutable cursor state and restore handling; parent xterm.js InputHandler registers OSC 12, setOrReportCursorColor raises the color event, and browser core routes it through ThemeService.modifyColors, as confirmed by direct minified-source reads. Contract: SPEC.md:2860-2861 says 'Full fidelity: colors, cursor movement, alternate screens, resize. If it works over plain SSH it must work here.' SPEC_impl.md:2689-2693 says color queries answer from the theme or colors the program set; the program's set value can consequently disagree with the viewer. The complete Grid streams section (:3009-3110) contains no cursor-color exception; grid_output.rs:42-48 names accepted blink differences, not this color omission. Fix direction: carry the effective cursor color (including reset semantics) in the grid state/frame, and have paintCursor use it instead of only the bundled theme. Suggested bucket: other, cursor-color/display correctness. Confidence: confirmed by source and contract analysis; no runtime behavior observed or reproduced. proposed_drop: false. possible_cover: none in caller-supplied neighbour records; prohibited coverage sources were not searched. Could-be-highest: false for the established cursor-color display/query discrepancy; no security or loss-of-work route established. Important attribution caveat: this omission already exists at range baseline 6e423e30068b62c6cfa276c6d720ee35bb70387a in grid-style.js:220-250 and grid_output.rs:460-476. Complete baseline-to-tip diffs for both files change comments only; git log lists only f560058d and 61e63232 touching them. This is NOT a new cursor-color regression for existing grid terminals introduced by f560058d.
